sources.name: GitHub issues of TanStack/table
sources.version: GitHub REST API 2022-11-28, state as of 2026-11-11
sources.license: GitHub Terms of Service (user content; only facts and our own summaries are kept)

provenance.notes: URL, number, title, state, dates, counts and labels are copied from the API response of each issue. Category, components, summary, resolution and lesson are written by the researcher (tools/extract/field-reports/curation) after reading the issue body returned by the search API and, for the issues listed in docs/research/field-reports.md, the full thread. daysOpen of an open issue is measured to the retrieval date. fixedBy is filled mechanically from merged pull requests that name the issue after a closing keyword. Reports marked needs-review state a cause that the researcher inferred from the symptom without a confirming statement in the issue.

reports.title: RTL Support
reports.summary: In 2017 the table had no RTL support; the request listed what it would need — reversed column order, reversed cell content direction, swapped previous/next pagination buttons. It took eight months to close.
reports.lesson: The table model exposes direction, and column order, pinning sides, resize and pagination all read it.

reports.title: RTL column resizing doesn't work
reports.summary: In RTL, column resizing worked backwards: dragging a handle toward the left shrank the column it should have widened. The headless resize logic computed the delta from pointer movement without a direction input, and the report stayed open for nineteen months until a direction option was added.
reports.lesson: The resize engine takes direction and applies the sign itself, so adapters cannot forget it; fixture: drag inline-end handle outward widens the column in both directions.

reports.title: Column Pinning in RTL document
reports.summary: In an RTL document, the column pinning offsets provided by the library (distance from left for start-pinned, from right for end-pinned) did not produce correct sticky positions. It was open for fifteen months.
reports.lesson: The table model returns pinning offsets in logical terms (inline-start/inline-end offsets) for the adapter to apply with logical insets.
